name: Microsoft
route_status_reason: Any record holder can still give notice of a proposal for the meeting floor, there is no controlling shareholder, and directors face majority voting.

director_voting.text: Majority voting: a director who gets more votes against than for must offer to resign.

name: Meta
route_status_reason: The notice route stays open, but Zuckerberg holds 60.8% of the vote and directors are elected by plurality, so outside votes signal views without deciding outcomes.

director_voting.text: Plurality voting: a director wins with any votes for, so votes against do not unseat anyone.

levers.text: Votes against directors who oversee AI risk

name: Tesla
route_status_reason: Tesla has not adopted the Texas ownership threshold, but its board could adopt one without a shareholder vote. A 2025 proposal to require shareholder approval for that failed narrowly. The notice window is short and the board is classified.

bylaw.text: A shareholder of record can bring a proposal with notice 45 to 75 days before the anniversary of the date last year's proxy was mailed, a shorter and earlier window than most. No minimum stake for proposals today.

threshold.text: None today. Tesla's 2025 proxy says the board has not adopted the Texas Section 21.373 threshold.

control.text: One class of stock. Musk holds 19.8% beneficially.

director_voting.text: Majority of shares present elects directors, but the board is classified, so only a third stand for election each year.

levers.text: Votes against directors who oversee AI risk
Exempt solicitations to other shareholders (form PX14A6G)
Floor proposals by advance notice under the bylaws

Proposals if Rule 14a-8 ends.label: Open for now

notes.text: 2025 vote: a proposal to require shareholder approval before adopting a Texas proposal threshold failed, 1.21 billion shares for to 1.23 billion against.
May 2025 bylaws require 3% ownership to bring a derivative lawsuit.
